name: increasing_angle
bird_in: bird_id; pred: not bird_released; not angle_adjusted
external_agent_out: active_bird; angle; min_angle; max_angle; angle_rate; angle_bias; angle_rad
global_out: Aim angle decreases while slingshot active

name: decreasing_force
bird_in: bird_id; pred: not bird_released; not force_locked
global_out: Pull strength ramps down until set_force

name: flying
bird_in: bird_id; x_bird; y_bird; vx_bird; vy_bird; pred: bird_released; not platform_slide_active; y_bird>0

name: platform_sliding
bird_in: bird_id; x_bird; y_bird; vx_bird; vy_bird; bird_radius; pred: bird_released; platform_slide_active; bird_sliding; vx_bird>0
global_out: Bird rolls on platform top edge

name: block_platform_rolling
block_in: x_block; y_block; block_width; block_height; vx_block; vy_block; v_block; pred: block_slide_active; block_sliding; vx_block>0; v_block>0

name: agent_movement
external_agent_in: x_agent; y_agent; vx_agent; vy_agent; timing_agent; pred: not agent_dead

name: collision_ground
bird_in: bird_id; x_bird; y_bird; vx_bird; vy_bird; pred: bird_released; y_bird<=0; vx_bird>0

name: explode_bird
bird_in: bird_id; bounce_count; x_bird; pred: bird_released; angle_adjusted; bounce_count>=3 or x_bird>=800
global_out: End shot; advance to next bird

name: collision_pig_kill
bird_in: bird_id; v_bird; x_bird; y_bird; vx_bird; vy_bird; bird_radius; m_bird
pig_out: x_pig; y_pig; pig_radius; m_pig; pig_life; pred: not pig_dead

name: collision_block_bounce_off
bird_in: bird_id; v_bird; x_bird; y_bird; bird_radius; vx_bird; vy_bird; bird_block_damage
block_in: x_block; y_block; block_width; block_height; block_life; block_stability

name: collision_block
bird_in: bird_id; v_bird; x_bird; y_bird; bird_radius; vx_bird; vy_bird; bird_block_damage
block_in: x_block; y_block; block_width; block_height; block_life; block_stability

name: remove_unsupported_block
block_in: ?bl_top: x_block; y_block; block_width; block_height; block_life; block_stability | ?bl_bottom: x_block; y_block; block_life; block_stability
global_out: Top block falls when support gone

name: explode_block
block_in: ?bl_tnt: x_block; y_block; pred: block_explosive; block_life<=0 | ?bl_near: x_block; y_block; block_life; block_stability (±100)

name: remove_unsupported_pig
pig_in: x_pig; y_pig; pig_radius; pred: not pig_dead
block_in: ?bl_bottom: x_block; y_block; block_width; block_height; block_life; block_stability
global_in: Pig dies when support block fails

name: collision_block_pig_kill
pig_in: x_pig; y_pig; pig_radius; pred: not pig_dead
block_in: x_block; y_block; block_width; block_height; block_life; v_block>10

name: collision_platform
bird_in: bird_id; x_bird; y_bird; v_bird; vx_bird; bird_radius; pred: bird_released; not platform_slide_active; v_bird>0
bird_out: y_bird; vx_bird; v_bird; vy_bird=0; pred: platform_slide_active; bird_sliding

name: platform_slide_handoff
bird_in: x_bird; bird_radius; vx_bird; pred: platform_slide_active; bird_sliding(?b,?from); vx_bird>0
platform_in: x_platform; platform_width; platform_line_c; platform_slope; pred: platform_chain(?from,?to)

name: platform_slide_stop
bird_in: vx_bird; bounce_count; pred: platform_slide_active; bird_sliding; vx_bird<=0; bounce_count<3

name: collision_block_platform
block_in: x_block; y_block; block_width; block_height; block_life; v_block; vx_block; vy_block; pred: not block_slide_active
block_out: y_block; vy_block=0; v_block; pred: block_slide_active; block_sliding
platform_in: x_platform; platform_width; platform_top_y_min; platform_top_y_max; platform_height; platform_line_c; platform_slope

name: block_platform_roll_handoff
block_in: x_block; block_width; block_height; vx_block; pred: block_slide_active; block_sliding(?bl,?from)
platform_in: x_platform; platform_width; platform_line_c; platform_slope; pred: platform_chain(?from,?to)

name: block_platform_roll_end
block_in: vx_block; v_block; x_block; block_width; pred: block_slide_active; block_sliding

name: explode_block_from_bird
global_out: Black bird / tap explosion hits blocks

name: explode_pig_from_bird
bird_in: bird_id; bird_type; bounce_count; x_bird; y_bird; pred: platform_slide_active optional

name: explode_pig_from_egg
bird_in: bird_id; bird_type; bounce_count; x_bird; y_bird; pred: bird_type=3; bounce_count=3; bird_tapped

name: agent_1_timed_change_direction
external_agent_in: agent_type; timing_agent; vx_agent; vy_agent; pred: not agent_dead; agent_type=1

name: agent_x_border_change_direction
external_agent_in: x_agent; agent_width; vx_agent; x_min_border; x_max_border; pred: not agent_dead

name: agent_y_border_change_direction
external_agent_in: y_agent; agent_height; vy_agent; y_min_border; y_max_border; pred: not agent_dead
